item.title: New handling fee to make ordering from China on average €6 more expensive per package
item.description: The Dutch government plans to introduce a handling fee for packages from outside the European Union in early January.

item.title: Video: Police chase ends when car slams into tree in The Hague; Three dead, one hurt
item.description: A car crashed into a tree and caught fire during a police chase in The Hague on Thursday morning. The car being pursued by the police is now upside down and burnt out.

item.title: Nearly 201,000 vacant homes in the Netherlands, 11% in Amsterdam alone
item.description: The Netherlands passed the threshold of 200,000 empty homes this summer, even as the country continues to face acute housing shortages.

item.title: Court acquits singer Marco Borsato of child sex abuse with 15-year-old girl
item.description: The court in Utrecht acquitted Marco Borsato of sexually assaulting a 15-year-old girl, the daughter of the woman who chaired his fan club.

item.title: Dordrecht cemetery opened 30 coffins for experiments without consent
item.description: A cemetery in Dordrecht opened 30 coffins in burial vaults multiple times without the surviving relatives’ knowledge or consent.
